admission.scope: Independent improvement on two-blade and fist builds; original Duelist fallback on other bodies. Overall league rating is not a build-specific prediction.

review.notes: Chrome review on isolated 127.0.0.1:5199, actual arena UI and physical bodies. Both corners AI controlled. Visible contacts, damage, independent arm poses and completed verdicts; no browser errors. Capture reported approximately 1 fps, so this validates visible states and runtime behavior, not animation smoothness. Existing x4 control used for fists and fallback. Owned tab and Vite stopped; user server processes retained. These illustrative wins are not statistical evidence; independent headless confirmation supplies that.
